- **Goss wilt**: Shows water-soaked lesions with black freckling, but on green tissue with different pattern
- **Southern corn leaf blight**: Tan rectangular lesions, not scattered black dots

The pattern of many small raised black structures (stromata) on dried tan corn tissue is the hallmark of **Tar spot**.
